content: Postgres in Proxmox LXC: snapshots are crash-consistent only (like pulling power); vzdump snapshot mode can capture mid-transaction state — pair with pg_dump/pg_basebackup logical backups. LXC memory limit hit = OOM-kill of postgres (no graceful throttle); postgres sees host's total RAM for some sysctls unless tuned, shared_buffers sizing should use the LXC limit not host RAM. Bind mounts break PBS snapshot backups unless flagged. Sources: Proxmox forum threads, pve-docs chapter-pct, metasora blog.
